items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Clark Terry, Snooky Young, all giants... And we saw each other more than we saw our kids... When he told me that Clark was going to do it... I had no idea he was this good. Because this is the Clark I remember and loved from the last picture.

ctx.x: You know I’m not being false modesty and any of that kind of stuff. It was one of the better ones. Clark is, Clark Terry has the knack, he’s a catalyst and he makes everybody — he kicks everybody in the butt and makes them play, whether they want to or not.
The people watching this didn’t get the benefit to see the rehearsal that went into that, but — the five minutes.
